summary: Meiwu Technology Co Ltd, via its wholly-owned subsidiary Xiamen Chunshang Health Technology Co., Ltd, entered a definitive equity transfer agreement on August 20, 2026 to acquire 100% of Xiamen Hemeitong Commercial Co., Ltd from its two shareholders for RMB 23.52M (~$35M) cash. An independent valuation advisor, Beijing Yingyue Asset Appraisal, valued the target at RMB 239.4M (~$35.28M) as of June 30, 2026, implying a near-zero premium. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions and aims to integrate Hemeitong's distributor network into the MOBO AI skincare platform. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration execution.
